support.title: Support Center
support.subtitle: We're here to help

faq1.q: How do I connect my Instagram profile?
faq1.a: Just enter the @ of the public profile you want to monitor. No Instagram login required. Our AI only collects comments from public profiles.

faq2.q: How long does the first analysis take?
faq2.a: Timing varies by network, period, volume, and provider availability. The forecast appears before collection and progress remains visible during processing.

faq3.a: Yes! You can monitor any public profile, including competitors. It's great for sentiment benchmarking.

faq4.q: How does the crisis alert work?
faq4.a: When the percentage of negative comments exceeds the threshold you set, the system sends a notification via email and/or on the dashboard.

faq5.a: Yes. We use end-to-end encryption, Brazilian servers, and are LGPD compliant.

faq6.q: Can I cancel at any time?
faq6.a: Yes. No fines or red tape. When you cancel, your account is paused and you can reactivate whenever you want.

differences.savedAnalyzed: {count} saved items have not had an analysis attempt yet.

funnel.noDifferences: The available stages keep the same denominator.
funnel.unknownExplanation: N/A means the stage was not instrumented in this same scope; the product does not estimate it.
funnel.invalidExplanation: This snapshot does not form a monotonic funnel. Analytical metrics must be treated as unreconciled.

provenance.title: How this score was calculated
provenance.description: This is the evidence trail for the displayed scope. It does not start collection or change data.
provenance.descriptionUnavailable: The trail below shows why the data did not produce a valid analysis. It does not start collection or change data.
provenance.periodHelp: The score and counts below are limited to this scope.
provenance.collectionLimits: Recorded limits: {posts} posts, {comments} comments per post, since {since}.

all.label: All eligible items
all.description: The run requested every eligible item up to the recorded limits. This does not mean unrestricted network access.

sample.label: Legacy selection without a proven method
sample.description: This older run recorded the ‘sample’ mode. There is not enough evidence to treat it as a statistical or representative sample.

engagement.label: Engagement prioritization
engagement.description: For public Instagram, the run ranked the candidates returned by the source by likes and limited analysis. This selection is biased and does not represent the full conversation.

incremental.label: Incremental update
incremental.description: The run looked for new content since the recorded checkpoint.

analysis_only.label: Analysis only
analysis_only.description: No new collection occurred; the run analyzed items that were already saved.

not_recorded.label: Mode not recorded
not_recorded.description: There is not enough evidence to state how collection was configured.

coverageReasons.complete_window: Period, profiles, and analyses meet the recorded criteria for this window.
coverageReasons.analysis_incomplete: Some saved items do not have a valid analysis yet.
coverageReasons.latest_attempt_failed: The latest attempt failed; current coverage cannot be confirmed.
coverageReasons.no_saved_items: No items were saved in the scope, so there is no basis for evaluation.
coverageReasons.expected_window_not_recorded: The expected window was not recorded; the product does not assume full coverage.

global.errorDescription: Freshness and coverage could not be confirmed. Avoid interpreting insights until this status is restored.
global.noSnapshotDescription: There is no collection with a recorded period, coverage, and denominators yet. If historical data already exists, treat it only as historical and refresh it before interpreting the present.

language.current: Valid window: this reading may represent the monitored moment.
language.healthy_limited_coverage: Recent data, but coverage is not enough to describe the current moment.
language.healthy_without_valid_data: The connection is recent, but there are no valid analyses to interpret yet.
language.partial: Partial run: this reading includes only the valid data that was preserved.
language.partial_without_history: The run was partial and left no valid basis for evaluation.
language.degraded: Historical reading preserved; the latest update needs verification.
language.degraded_without_history: The update is degraded and there is no valid preserved basis for evaluation.
language.stale: Historical reading: the data is outside its update window.
language.stale_without_history: The data is out of date and there is no valid basis to interpret.
language.failed_with_history: The update failed; this is only the last valid historical reading.
language.failed_without_history: The update failed and there is no valid basis for evaluation yet.
language.never_synced: There is no completed collection available to evaluate this profile yet.

preflight.partialWarning: Your balance doesn't cover the full estimate (~{missing} credits short). Analysis will run as far as your balance allows; the rest stays pending.
preflight.noCredits: You're out of credits. Get a plan or a credit pack to analyze.
preflight.nothingPending: No comments pending analysis for this profile.
preflight.incrementalNote: Incremental collection: only posts and comments newer than {date}.
preflight.demographicsDesc: Enriches commenter demographic profiles. Cost: {cost} credits per new profile found.
